images.description: v3 Home: one flat list under day labels. The conversation in progress leads Today (even above a call that started after it) with the breathing dot and its running length; the tiles show transcribing (spinner), writing (pen), done (emoji; the test engine has no emoji font, so emoji draw as boxes) and failed (warning mark, never the emoji). Yesterday carries a chevron that opens the day summary; Today has none.
Opening the conversation in progress: the pen and 'Writing your summary…' over a skeleton while the summary is written.
The summary streaming in section by section; the pen stays until the summary is stored.
The same v3 Home in the light theme, including the failed tile.
